resources.string: Local-only digital account organizer. This app stays offline, does not connect to external services, and never stores service passwords.
Enter your app-specific master password to unlock the encrypted local database.
Never enter a service password here. This organizer records account metadata only and never stores external credentials.

CSV exports are unencrypted plaintext files intended for spreadsheet review. They may expose email addresses, usernames, recovery contact references, and notes, and do not preserve custom service logos or full relational structure.
